title: nan
authors: Kim J.; Lin K.; Nogar S.M.; Larkin D.; Korpela C.M.
key_contribution: Presents an integrated system for detecting and localizing ground objects using a UAS paired with a mobile computing device in GPS-denied areas.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
